740 N. Dalton Ave.

DATE AND TIME:
Wednesday, August 20, 2014
06:30 P.M.
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Azusa is hereby called to be held Wednesday, August 20, 2014 at 06:30 p.m. at Azusa Senior Center.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
1.
The meeting will be held from 6:30 p.m. to 7:45 p.m.; Council will recess at 7:45 p.m. at City Hall, 213 E. Foothill Blvd., Azusa, to discuss the Closed Session items listed on the agenda.
2.
Call to Order
3.
Roll Call
B.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
Limited to items listed on this Special Meeting Notice.
C.
INFORMATION ITEM
1.
Staff will give a brief overview of the possibility of contracting out Azusa Transit services and answer questions from the public.
D.
CLOSED SESSION
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION
Prior to going into closed session the City Council will take public comment on the closed session items only.
Council will meet in the City Manager's Office at City Hall, 213 E. Foothill Blvd. Azusa, do discuss the following items:
1.
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE RELEASE Pursuant to California Government Code, Section 54957 Title: Accept Resignation of City Manager.
2.
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT Pursuant to California Government Code, Section 54957 Title: Interim City Manager/ City Manager
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
